text: Interior lab scene against a white wall. Left foreground: a bench-top balance with blue-and-white body, colored keypad and display, sitting on a white table; a black cable runs from it, and a dark cable hangs down the wall above. Center: a raised white platform on two cylindrical posts, carrying a dark upright tube or vial holder with a bright orange cap at its top; behind it a black rack holding a row of dark round caps, and a small white boxy instrument with a grey top. A black-and-white square fiducial marker is mounted below the platform. Right: a tall grey vertical rail column with bolt heads. Far right background: blue equipment, a metal canister, and a white tray. No liquid is visible.
